question: Into which locus below the navel should the seed be caused to fall?
premises: The location is specified as below the navel
The locus is called the consciousness-pit
Deposition into the vagina is prescribed
inference: One should cause the seed to fall into the vagina, in the consciousness-pit below the navel.
uncertainties: The precise referent of cit-kuṇḍa as anatomical or subtle locus is ambiguous
plain_english: Below the navel, in the consciousness-pit, in the vagina, one should cause it to fall.
